name: Tooth Fairy
bio: Archetype: AoE Healing, Cleanser, Crit Debuff. ⌽ Provides passive healing, Crit Rate and Crit DMG debuffs for free by consuming [Baby Tooth]. ⌽ P2 allows near-permanent uptime on debuffs. ⌽ S1 can apply [Confusion] at Rank 1 (Most skills that apply [Confusion] only do so at Rank 2/3). ⌽ Heal on S2 and Ultimate have increased Crit Rate (Yes, Heals can Crit). ⌽ Ult deals ST Mental damage and cleanses all allies on Crit.
